cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you put your coat on, let me conclude our coffee properly. Leaving and concluding are different things.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said ten minutes. My bus is due.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ten minutes describes duration, not closure. Sit down, please; I'll decide whether we've reached a suitable stopping point.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cafe is closing. They've asked both of us to leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we continue on the pavement. They manage the premises; I am managing this conversation. Wait beside the door until I release you.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 formal conclusion and A3 duration correction impose sole permission to depart.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 bus deadline and B4 closing premises form coherent successive departure pressures.

relationship.evidence: B2 gives a practical time limit; B4 cites an immediate venue demand rather than prompting a lesson.

heightening.evidence: B4 eviction causes A5 pavement continuation but the premises/conversation contrast is a detachable explanation.

specificity.evidence: A1 coffee companion preparing to leave and B2 bus establish the understandable social trap.
